closing_speed_semantics.negative: leader is pulling away from the follower
closing_speed_semantics.positive: follower is closing on the leader
closing_speed_semantics.stage_0_1_conflict: Stage 0.1 validation risk used relative_speed_mps = leader_speed - follower_speed, the opposite sign; Stage 0.5 states must not reuse that interpretation
closing_speed_semantics.ttc_rule: ttc_s = net_gap_m / closing_speed_mps when net_gap_m > 0 and closing_speed_mps > NGSIM_CLOSING_EPSILON_MPS

net_gap_semantics.reference_point: SUMO vehicle position on lane (front bumper along the lane)
net_gap_semantics.verification_scope: engineering fixture only: three vType pairs plus a stopped-equilibrium probe; no reality claim

invalid.ngsim_condition: matched leader with non-positive net gap

missing__identity_or_clock.ngsim_condition: leader not matched, unobservable match fields, conflicting clock/frame
missing__identity_or_clock.note: NGSIM collection/identity defects map onto the simulator's identity-resolution failure

missing__no_reported_leader.ngsim_condition: no leader reported in the source record (labelled missing)
missing__no_reported_leader.note: documented, approved asymmetry: in NGSIM the absence of a leader record is counted as an observation limitation (missing), while in SUMO the absence of a leader is a genuine traffic state (not_applicable).  No leader row can enter reliable-following exposure in either pipeline, so the P2 denominator is unaffected; comparisons of raw status composition must use this crosswalk.

missing__unobservable_input.ngsim_condition: leader matched but speed/headway fields unusable
missing__unobservable_input.note: SUMO output defects must stay zero rows; the label exists for fail-closed behaviour

not_applicable.ngsim_condition: matched leader and positive net gap but no closing

valid.ngsim_condition: matched leader, positive net gap, closing speed above epsilon
